description: The totp() expression (ADR 01216) with no live authenticator: it returns a 6-digit code, two calls in the same window return the same code, $VAR substitution reaches the secret inside {{...}}, and a bad secret keeps the {{...}} text verbatim. Shell-only, so it runs on every OS.

tests.description: A braced and a bare totp() call in one step resolve in the same window, so they match and are each 6 digits.

steps.description: Export the RFC 6238 test secret, standing in for a CI secret.
Generate two codes from the secret through $VAR substitution.
Both codes are 6 digits and equal.
steps.runShell: node -e "const a = process.env.TOTP_FIXTURE_A, b = process.env.TOTP_FIXTURE_B; if (!/^[0-9]{6}$/.test(a) || a !== b) { console.error('bad codes:', a, b); process.exit(1) }"

tests.description: A secret that isn't base32 leaves the {{...}} text in place and logs a warning.

steps.runShell: node -e "const v = process.env.TOTP_FIXTURE_BAD; if (!v.startsWith('{{totp(') || !v.endsWith(')}}')) { console.error('not verbatim:', v); process.exit(1) }"
